title: Nnipadɔm a Wɔayera no
intro: Wogyina mpɔtam bi a wɔakyerɛw wɔn asɛm wɔ asorɔkye mu no nnyigyei anim. Saa akra yi tee ɔfrɛ bi, wɔpaw asɔretia, na wohyiaa nea efii mu bae a ɛsan hyehyɛɛ asase no. Henanom ne wɔn, na dɛn na ɛbaa wɔn wiase no so?
clues: Yɛtenaa ase tete, na ɔbɔfo bi fi yɛn mu baa yɛn nkyɛn.
Yɛsom abosom anum na yɛampene so sɛ yebegyaw.
Yedii ɔbɔfo no ho fɛw bɔɔ no sobo sɛ wayera.
Yɛhwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔmfa asotwe no mmra sɛ ɔka nokware a.
Yehuu sɛ wim retɔ osu na asase retu nsuten.
Yɛforo kɔɔ mmeae a ɛkorɔn no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a yeguan, nanso asorɔkye no twaa yɛn so.

outcome.answer: Yɛn nyinaa yeraeɛ gyese agyidifoɔ a wɔne Nuh

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
